pointers.sentence: It asks no model's permission; the model admins do, page by page ([Permissions in the admin: `has_change_permission` and the others](admin-permissions.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.has_permission`).

It is asked by `admin_view` on every request but the login's, by the login, and by `each_context`, whose `"has_permission"` shows the user's links in the header (`django/contrib/admin/templates/admin/base.html`).

`staff_member_required` puts the same test on a view outside the site, sending a refused request to `"admin:login"`; admindocs uses it (`django/contrib/admin/views/decorators.py:staff_member_required`).

Every page of the admin, the model admins' included, starts its context from `AdminSite.each_context`, all but the change list's "Database error" page and the page that closes a popup (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.each_context`, `django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin.changelist_view`, `django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin.response_add`):

`"log_entries"` is not evaluated until the index's `get_admin_log` tag takes the user's last ten rows (`django/contrib/admin/templatetags/log.py:AdminLogNode.render`) ([The log and the history: `LogEntry` and `history_view`](log.md)).

A model kept gets its plural verbose name, its permissions, the change list's URL when the user may view or change, with `"view_only"` true when the user may only view, and the add page's URL when the user may add, grouped under its application config's `verbose_name` (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite._build_app_dict`).
`get_app_list` sorts applications and models by name; the documentation suggests overriding it to reorder (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.get_app_list`, `docs/ref/contrib/admin/index.txt`).
`get_app_list` sorts applications and models by name; the documentation suggests overriding it to reorder (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.get_app_list`, `docs/ref/contrib/admin/index.txt`).
`AdminSite.index` renders `AdminSite.index_template` or `"admin/index.html"` with the list and `AdminSite.index_title`, "Site administration" (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.index`).
An empty list raises `Http404`, so staff with no permission in an application get a 404 for it, as nora did at /admin/auth/ (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.app_index`).

It hands the request to `LoginView`, with `AdminSite.login_form` or `AdminAuthenticationForm` and `AdminSite.login_template` or `"admin/login.html"` ([The login and password views: `LoginView`, `LogoutView` and `PasswordChangeView`](../auth/login-views.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.login`).
A user who passes `has_permission` and opens the login page is sent to `"next"`, no longer always to the index (`docs/releases/6.1.txt`).

`AdminAuthenticationForm` asks for "a staff account" in its message for `"invalid_login"`, and its `confirm_login_allowed`, after the parent's, refuses a user who is not staff with that message and code ([The authentication forms: `AuthenticationForm` and the password forms](../auth/user-forms.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/forms.py:AdminAuthenticationForm.confirm_login_allowed`).

Unless a safe `"next"` or `LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URL` sends the user elsewhere, it renders `AdminSite.logout_template` or `"registration/logged_out.html"`, a template the admin ships (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.logout`, `django/contrib/auth/views.py:LogoutView.post`).

Unless a safe `"next"` or `LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URL` sends the user elsewhere, it renders `AdminSite.logout_template` or `"registration/logged_out.html"`, a template the admin ships (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.logout`, `django/contrib/auth/views.py:LogoutView.post`).

`AdminSite.password_change` is a `PasswordChangeView` with `AdminSite.password_change_form` or `django/contrib/admin/forms.py:AdminPasswordChangeForm`, a `PasswordChangeForm` with a CSS class for required fields, ending at `AdminSite.password_change_done`, a `PasswordChangeDoneView`; the admin ships both templates.

The session that made the change stays signed in ([The user of a request: `login`, `logout` and `AuthenticationMiddleware`](../auth/login.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.password_change`).
**Changed in 6.0.** `AdminSite.password_change_form` (`docs/releases/6.0.txt`).

`AdminSite.i18n_javascript` is a `JavaScriptCatalog` of the admin package's translations ([The language views: `set_language` and `JavaScriptCatalog`](../i18n/views.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.i18n_javascript`).

A change form's "View on site" link comes from `BaseModelAdmin.get_view_on_site_url`: none when `BaseModelAdmin.view_on_site` is false, a callable's URL, or, for an object with `get_absolute_url`, the site's `"view_on_site"` URL (`django/contrib/admin/options.py:BaseModelAdmin.get_view_on_site_url`).

`AdminSite.shortcut_view` raises `PermissionDenied` when the content type's model is registered and its model admin's `has_view_permission` is false, before any object is looked for; else it calls the content types' `shortcut` ([Content types, static files and the other contrib apps](../contrib.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.shortcut_view`).
Staff without the view or change permission now consistently get the 403 (`docs/releases/6.2.txt`).
